name: Segmented control
description: A compact row of mutually exclusive options, such as switching between views.

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value, for a controlled control.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value selected first. Defaults to the first option.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. Generated when omitted.

a11y: Native radios inside labels, in a role="radiogroup" with a name: arrow keys move the selection.
The selected segment is raised with a border and shadow, not shown by color alone.
